description: Seven orders from Harbour Homewares, a fictional merchant served by the east region (Sydney fulfilment centre) that joined the marketplace last week. Day 7 is yesterday. All times are Sydney time.
rules: Dispatched within 48 hours of being placed: the promise was met. Count it on the day it was dispatched.
Not dispatched when the 48 hours ran out: the promise was missed. Count it on the day the deadline passed, even if the order ships later.
Cancelled before its deadline: not counted. Cancelled after its deadline: still a missed promise.
Several dispatch attempts are still one order.
Test orders, which are soft-deleted, are ignored.
